# allExamsPYQ

allExamsPYQ is a previous-year-question practice platform for exam preparation. It supports exam browsing, timed practice tests, answer review, bookmarks, progress analytics, leaderboards, and admin-managed question content.

## Public Routes

- `/` - product overview and links to authentication.
- `/login` - sign in for students and admins.
- `/register` - student account creation when Supabase is configured.

## Notes For Automated Readers

Authenticated student and admin routes require a valid session. Demo mode is available in local development when Supabase environment variables are not configured.
